legal_units.title: Penalty for failure to comply with provisions of section 187.
legal_units.text: The Assessing Officer may impose on a person, a penalty of Rs. 5000 for every day of the duration of failure where he fails to provide a facility for accepting payments through the prescribed electronic modes of payment, as referred to in section 187.
legal_units.retrieval_text: Chapter XXI PENALTIES Section 452 Penalty for failure to comply with provisions of section 187. The Assessing Officer may impose on a person, a penalty of Rs. 5000 for every day of the duration of failure where he fails to provide a facility for accepting payments through the prescribed electronic modes of payment, as referred to in section 187.
